mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.resident_id, r.name AS resident_name, r.id_card AS resident_id_card, a.applicant_id, au.username AS applicant_username, a.apply_reason, a.evidence_text, a.local_employ_social, a.local_activity_90d, a.judge_version, a.status, a.review_comment, a.reviewer_id, ru.username AS reviewer_username, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM resident_judge_application_attachment aa WHERE aa.application_id = a.id) AS attachment_count, a.reviewed_at, a.created_at FROM resident_judge_application a LEFT JOIN resident r ON r.id = a.resident_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = a.applicant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = a.reviewer_id
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM resident_judge_application a LEFT JOIN resident r ON r.id = a.resident_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = a.applicant_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.status = #{status}
AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{residentName}, '%')
AND au.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{applicantUsername}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resident_judge_application ( resident_id, applicant_id, apply_reason, evidence_text, local_employ_social, local_activity_90d, judge_version, status ) VALUES ( #{residentId}, #{applicantId}, #{applyReason}, #{evidenceText}, #{localEmploySocial}, #{localActivity90d}, #{judgeVersion}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE resident_judge_application SET status = #{status}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
